verdict.rationale: Bitwarden offers CLI/API/MCP server access that agents could use, but there is no evidence of a mechanism for setting up autonomous, scheduled, or background-running automations (e.g., triggers, workflows, cron-like jobs) — it only provides interfaces for on-demand vault access. missing for 10: any documented scheduling/trigger/workflow automation feature, evidence of background/autonomous execution, or vendor claims of persistent automation setup.
